import datetime
import unittest
from decimal import Decimal

try:
    from tests.helpers import CATALOG
except ImportError:
    from helpers import CATALOG
from stockroom.parsing import ParseError, parse_catalog, parse_movements, parse_orders

CAT = parse_catalog(CATALOG)
D = datetime.date
P = parse_catalog
M = lambda t: parse_movements(t, CAT)
O = lambda t: parse_orders(t, CAT)
# parser -> (good line, bad line)
KINDS = {
    P: ("AB-100|x|1|0", "AB-100|x|1"),
    M: ("2024-03-01 AB-100 5", "2024-03-01 AB-100 0"),
    O: ("SO-1 2024-03-01 bob AB-100*1", "SO-1 2024-03-01 bob AB-100*0"),
}


class ParsingTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def bad(self, fn, text, line):
        with self.assertRaises(ParseError, msg=repr(text)) as c:
            fn(text)
        self.assertEqual(c.exception.line, line, repr(text))
        self.assertIn("line %d" % line, str(c.exception))

    def bad_rows(self, fn, template, values, line=1):
        for v in values:
            with self.subTest(v=v):
                self.bad(fn, template % v, line)

    def test_parse_error_type(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ParseError) as c:
            P("# c\n\nAB-100|x|12.505|0")
        e = c.exception
        self.assertIsInstance(e, ValueError)
        self.assertIsInstance(e.line, int)
        self.assertEqual(str(e), "line 3: bad price '12.505'")

    def test_line_numbers_count_blank_and_comment_lines(self):
        for fn, (_, bad) in KINDS.items():
            with self.subTest(bad=bad):
                self.bad(fn, "# c\n\n  \t \n\t# d\n" + bad, 5)

    def test_catalog_fields(self):
        c = P("ab-100|Garden gnome|12|5\nCd-205|Seed, \"mix\" # 1|1.5|0|Reduced\nEFGH-310|X|0.01|7|ZERO\n")
        self.assertEqual(list(c), ["AB-100", "CD-205", "EFGH-310"])
        got = [(p.sku, p.name, str(p.price), p.reorder, p.tax) for p in c.values()]
        self.assertEqual(got, [("AB-100", "Garden gnome", "12.00", 5, "standard"),
                               ("CD-205", 'Seed, "mix" # 1', "1.50", 0, "reduced"),
                               ("EFGH-310", "X", "0.01", 7, "zero")])
        self.assertIsInstance(c["AB-100"].price, Decimal)
        self.assertIsInstance(c["AB-100"].reorder, int)

    def test_catalog_price(self):
        for v, want in [("12", "12.00"), ("12.5", "12.50"), ("0.01", "0.01"), ("0.1", "0.10"), ("1000", "1000.00")]:
            with self.subTest(v=v):
                self.assertEqual(str(P("AB-100|x|%s|0" % v)["AB-100"].price), want)
        self.bad_rows(P, "AB-100|x|%s|0", ["12.505", "1,000.00", "-3", "abc", "0", "0.00", "", "12.", ".5", "+3", "١٢"])

    def test_catalog_reorder(self):
        self.assertEqual(P("AB-100|x|1|0")["AB-100"].reorder, 0)
        self.bad_rows(P, "AB-100|x|1|%s", ["-1", "1.5", "x", "", "١"])

    def test_catalog_tax(self):
        for v in ["standard", "Reduced", "ZERO", "zero"]:
            self.assertEqual(P("AB-100|x|1|0|%s" % v)["AB-100"].tax, v.lower())
        self.bad_rows(P, "AB-100|x|1|0|%s", ["", " ", "bogus", "std", "zero|x"])

    def test_catalog_sku(self):
        self.assertEqual(list(P("aBcD-123|x|1|0")), ["ABCD-123"])
        self.bad_rows(P, "%s|x|1|0", ["A-100", "ABCDE-100", "AB-10", "AB-1000", "AB100", "AB_100", "AB-10O", "",
                                      "AB-١٢٣", "ﬃ-100", "aﬃ-100", "KK-100", "ＡB-100"])

    def test_catalog_name(self):
        self.assertEqual(P("AB-100| aé | b c |1|0|zero")["AB-100"].name if False else
                         P("AB-100| aé b\x0bc\rd |1|0")["AB-100"].name, "aé b\x0bc\rd")
        self.bad_rows(P, "AB-100|%s|1|0", ["", "  \t "])
        self.bad(P, "AB-100|a|b|1|0", 1)

    def test_catalog_field_count(self):
        self.bad_rows(P, "%s", ["AB-100|x|1", "AB-100|x|1|0|zero|extra", "AB-100|x|1|0|", "AB-100", "AB-100|x|1|0||"])

    def test_catalog_duplicate_sku(self):
        for second in ["AB-100", "ab-100"]:
            self.bad(P, "AB-100|x|1|0\n# c\n%s|y|2|0" % second, 3)

    def test_catalog_trims_spaces_and_tabs_only(self):
        c = P(" \tab-100 \t|\t x  y |  1.5\t| 0 |\tReduced \t")
        self.assertEqual((c["AB-100"].name, str(c["AB-100"].price), c["AB-100"].tax), ("x  y", "1.50", "reduced"))
        self.bad_rows(P, "AB-100|x|%s|0", [" 1", "\x0b1", "1\x0c"])

    def test_movement_fields(self):
        ms = M("2024-03-01 ab-100 +20  first   delivery \t\n2024-03-02 \t CD-205 \t 40\n"
               "2024-03-04 AB-100 -3 \tout\n2024-03-05 AB-100 1 a\rb c\x0b\x0c\x85d\n")
        got = [(m.date, m.sku, m.quantity, m.note) for m in ms]
        self.assertEqual(got, [(D(2024, 3, 1), "AB-100", 20, "first   delivery"), (D(2024, 3, 2), "CD-205", 40, ""),
                               (D(2024, 3, 4), "AB-100", -3, "out"),
                               (D(2024, 3, 5), "AB-100", 1, "a\rb c\x0b\x0c\x85d")])

    def test_movement_quantity(self):
        for v, want in [("+20", 20), ("-3", -3), ("40", 40)]:
            self.assertEqual(M("2024-01-01 EF-310 100\n2024-01-02 EF-310 %s" % v)[1].quantity, want)
        self.bad_rows(M, "2024-01-01 EF-310 %s", ["0", "+0", "-0", "1.5", "x", "--1", "+-1", "1e2", "١٢"])

    def test_movement_date(self):
        self.assertEqual(M("2024-02-29 AB-100 1")[0].date, D(2024, 2, 29))
        self.bad_rows(M, "%s AB-100 1", ["2024-02-30", "2024-2-3", "0000-01-01", "2023-02-29", "2024-13-01",
                                        "24-01-01", "2024/01/01", "٢024-01-01"])

    def test_movement_sku_and_field_count(self):
        self.bad_rows(M, "2024-03-01 %s 1", ["ZZ-999", "AB-10", "ﬃ-100"])
        self.bad_rows(M, "%s", ["2024-03-01 AB-100", "2024-03-01", "AB-100 1"])

    def test_movement_stock_below_zero_in_date_order(self):
        self.bad(M, "# c\n\n2024-03-01 AB-100 5\n2024-03-02 AB-100 -6", 4)
        # later file line with an earlier date: counting order is l1, l3, l2 -> l2 crosses zero
        self.bad(M, "2024-03-01 AB-100 5\n2024-03-05 AB-100 -3\n2024-03-02 AB-100 -4", 2)
        self.bad(M, "2024-03-05 AB-100 5\n\n2024-03-01 AB-100 -1", 3)
        self.assertEqual(len(M("2024-03-05 AB-100 -3\n2024-03-01 AB-100 5")), 2)
        self.assertEqual(len(M("2024-03-01 AB-100 5\n2024-03-01 AB-100 -3")), 2)
        self.bad(M, "2024-03-01 AB-100 -3\n2024-03-01 AB-100 5", 1)
        self.bad(M, "2024-03-01 AB-100 5\n2024-03-02 CD-205 -1", 2)
        got = M("2024-03-05 AB-100 -3\n2024-03-01 AB-100 5")
        self.assertEqual([m.quantity for m in got], [-3, 5])

    def test_order_fields(self):
        os_ = O("so-7 2024-03-03 acme CD-205*3,ab-100*12\nSO-007 2024-03-04\tBea  AB-100*1\n")
        self.assertEqual([(o.id, o.date, o.customer, o.lines) for o in os_],
                         [("SO-7", D(2024, 3, 3), "acme", [("CD-205", 3), ("AB-100", 12)]),
                          ("SO-007", D(2024, 3, 4), "Bea", [("AB-100", 1)])])

    def test_order_id(self):
        for a, b in [("SO-7", "SO-7"), ("SO-7", "so-7"), ("sO-7", "So-7")]:
            self.bad(O, "%s 2024-03-01 a AB-100*1\n#\n%s 2024-03-01 b AB-100*1" % (a, b), 3)
        self.bad_rows(O, "%s 2024-03-01 a AB-100*1", ["SO7", "SO-", "XO-1", "SO-1a", "SO-١", "S0-1", "-1"])

    def test_order_lines(self):
        self.bad_rows(O, "SO-1 2024-03-01 a %s", [
            "AB-100*0", "AB-100*+2", "AB-100*-1", "AB-100*1.5", "AB-100*", "AB-100", "AB-100*1,", ",AB-100*1", "*1",
            "AB-100*1,,CD-205*1", "ZZ-999*1", "AB-100*1,ab-100*2", "AB-100*١", "AB-100*x", "AB-100*1*2"])
        self.assertEqual(O("SO-1 2024-03-01 a AB-100*10")[0].lines, [("AB-100", 10)])

    def test_order_date_and_field_count(self):
        self.bad_rows(O, "%s", ["SO-1 2024-02-30 a AB-100*1", "SO-1 2024-03-01 a", "SO-1 2024-03-01 a AB-100*1 x",
                                "SO-1 2024-03-01 a AB-100*1, CD-205*2"])

    def test_bom_only_at_start_is_ignored(self):
        for fn, (good, bad) in KINDS.items():
            with self.subTest(good=good):
